features.title: Snapping timeline
features.description: Clips snap into place and close their own gaps, so the edit stays tidy while you move fast.
features.short: Clips snap into place and gaps close themselves as you edit.

features.title: Ripple trim
features.description: Trim one clip and everything after it moves with it, keeping sound and picture in sync.
features.short: Trim one clip and everything after it moves with it, in sync.
features.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 3v10M10 3v10M3 6l-1.5 2L3 10M13 6l1.5 2L13 10"/></svg>

features.title: Realtime scopes
features.description: Waveform, vectorscope and histogram update with every adjustment, so you grade by eye and by numbers.
features.short: Waveform, vectorscope and histogram update with every grade.

features.title: Transcript editing
features.description: Delete a sentence from the transcript and the cut follows. Edit an interview the way you edit a document.
features.short: Delete a sentence in the transcript and the cut follows.
